title: Zachary Morford
text:
I’m a behavioral scientist and data analyst with a background spanning applied behavior analysis, behavioral economics, and machine learning. My work sits at the intersection of rigorous behavioral science and modern data tools — I use R, SQL, and machine learning to turn complex clinical and organizational data into actionable insight.
Currently, I work as a Clinical Data Analyst at Centria Healthcare, where I develop novel clinical metrics, build PowerBI dashboards, and apply predictive modeling to improve outcomes for thousands of ABA clients and clinicians. Before moving into industry, I spent several years as a faculty member and researcher, publishing on topics including gamification, disequilibrium theory, and behavioral health.
I’m particularly interested in how behavioral science principles can be operationalized at scale — whether through clinical data systems, organizational design, or technology.

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Professional Experience

Industry
Clinical Data Analyst | Centria Healthcare | Dallas, TX & Westminster, CO (Remote) | 2022 – Present

Developed a novel clinical metric enabling tracking of client goal progress and behavior reduction across 3,000+ clients and 350+ clinicians.
Built PowerBI dashboards integrating novel metrics, giving clinical leaders real-time visibility into client outcomes.
Applied random forest models to identify controllable clinical variables most predictive of client outcomes.

Data Analyst | Behavioral Health Center of Excellence (BHCOE) | Dallas, TX (Remote) | 2021 – 2022

Produced industry research reports on pay and turnover derived from 17,000+ direct care staff, BCBAs, and clinical directors.
Built an LDA topic model to surface and structure customer feedback patterns at scale.
Identified key drivers of employee turnover through predictive models spanning 100+ organizations; findings presented at CalABA 2022.
Applied machine learning (regression, random forest) to identify clinical variables most associated with quality of ABA care.

Secretary-Treasurer | Texas Association for Behavior Analysis (TxABA) | 2021 – 2023
Behavioral Economist | The Fabulous | 2018 – 2019
Executive Director | Texas Association for Behavior Analysis (TxABA) | Dallas, TX | 2018 – 2021

Managed a $400,000+ budget to support organizational operations and strategic priorities.
Served 1,500+ attendees at multiple annual behavior analysis conferences, including a pivot at the onset of COVID-19.
More than doubled TxABA committee engagement and grew conference attendance 10% following execution of a board-aligned strategic plan.

Consultant | ChangePartner, Inc. | Wilmington, DE | 2017

Integrated instructional design principles to improve delivery of behaviorally based feedback systems.
Conducted user testing of paper and electronic prototypes to inform early-stage product development.

Classroom Facilitator | Koan School | Denton, TX | 2016 – 2017

Delivered evidence-based math and science instruction grounded in the Morningside Model of Generative Instruction and Direct Instruction for students ages 8–13.



Academic Appointments
Assistant Professor | The Chicago School of Professional Psychology (TCSPP) | Dallas, TX | 2018 – 2023

Trained 50+ graduate students across applied behavior analysis, ethics, research methods, experimental analysis of behavior, verbal behavior, and scientific writing.

Post-Doctoral Fellow | University of Vermont Center on Behavior and Health | Burlington, VT | 2015 – 2016

Applied principles from behavioral economics and behavioral pharmacology to research chronic disease and health behavior promotion.
Conducted research on tobacco and nicotine regulation to understand behavioral and health consequences of regulatory decisions.
